emptyHint: Ask about the data in the current module, or whether a folder is safe to remove. The assistant answers from what it is told and never deletes anything on its own.
inputPlaceholder: Ask something… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)

askQuestion.file: What is the file "{{target}}"? What is it for? Is it safe to delete, and what could happen if I do?
askQuestion.folder: What is the folder "{{target}}" used for? Is it safe to delete, and what could happen if I do?
askQuestion.model: What is the AI model "{{target}}"? Is it normal for it to take up this much space? Is it safe to delete, and what could happen if I do?

resizeHint: Drag to resize, double-click to reset
resizeHintCustom: Drag to resize, double-click to reset

tool.selectNotFound: Those items are no longer there. The data may have changed; please scan again.
tool.selected: Selected {{count}} for you: {{names}}. Delete them from the page when you are ready.
tool.readEmpty: Nothing to read: that item may no longer exist, or it does not match the summary.
tool.moduleNoData: The "{{module}}" module has no scan data yet — run a scan there first, then ask again.
tool.selectNotProvided: The "{{module}}" module does not support selecting items — pick them yourself in the UI, then use its own delete button.
tool.deleteNotProvided: The "{{module}}" module does not support deletion — it is view-only, so remove things yourself in the UI.
tool.noConclusion: The data was fetched (see the messages above), but the model did not give a conclusion. Ask again to continue, or rephrase the question.
tool.answerFromKnowledge: (That is as far as the lookups go. If you still don't have the data you need, answer the user's question from your own knowledge and say which parts are inference — stop asking for more data.)
tool.moduleNotReady: The module "{{module}}" is not connected to the assistant right now, or has been unmounted. Open that module and try again.
tool.readNotProvided: The module "{{module}}" does not provide detail reading, so file level content is not available.
tool.detailNotProvided: The module "{{module}}" does not provide per item detail.

delete.title: The assistant asks to delete:
delete.warning: A backup is taken first; items marked as irreversible cannot be recovered.
delete.needsReboot: Some changes need Explorer to restart before they take effect.
delete.wrongModule: That proposal came from a different module, which you have since left. Go back to it, or ask again.

needConfig: No AI provider is configured yet. Add one with its API key under Settings - AI assistant, then you can ask questions here.
attachImage: Add an image (or paste a screenshot)
attachTooMany: Up to {{count}} images at a time
streamTimeout: No response for a long time, so this request was stopped. Try again, or switch model or provider.
switchModelFailed: Could not switch to that model: {{message}}
